description_en: Updates the information about a live stream transcoding template
name: UpdateLiveTranscodeTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template ID. To obtain the template ID, log on to the Intelligent Media Services (IMS) console (https://ims.console.aliyun.com/summary), choose Real-time Media Processing > Template Management, and then click the Transcoding tab. Alternatively, find the ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449217.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID。可以通过台智能媒体服务控制台 (https://ims.console.aliyun.com/summary)>模板管理>实时转码模板或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449217.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: template_id

fields.help_en: The bitrate of the output audio. Unit: Kbit/s. Valid values: 1 to 1000
fields.help_zh: 转码音频比特率。单位：kbps，取值：1~1000
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en: The number of sound channels. Valid values: 1: mono 2: binaural
fields.help_zh:
音频声道数。取值
1：单声道。
2：双声道
fields.name: channels

fields.help_en: The audio codec. Valid values: AAC MP3
fields.help_zh:
音频编码格式。取值：
AAC
MP3
fields.name: codec

fields.help_en:
The audio codec profile. Valid values when the Codec parameter is set to AAC:

aac_low

aac_he

aac_he_v2

aac_ld
fields.help_zh:
音频编码预置。当Codec为AAC时，取值：

aac_low
aac_he
aac_he_v2
aac_ld
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en:
The audio sampling rate. Valid values: 22050 to 96000.

Note If you set AudioProfile to aac_ld, the audio sampling rate cannot exceed 44100
fields.help_zh:
音频采样率。取值：22050~96000。

注意如果AudioProfile取值为aac_ld，则采样率不能超过44100
fields.name: samplerate

fields.help_en: The bitrate of the output video. Unit: Kbit/s. Valid values: 1 to 6000
fields.help_zh: 转码视频比特率。单位：kbps，取值：1~6000
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en:
The encoding type. Valid values:

H.264

H.265
fields.help_zh:
编码类型。可选值：

H.264
H.265
fields.name: codec

fields.help_en: The frame rate of the output video. Unit: frames per second (FPS). Valid values: 1 to 60
fields.help_zh: 转码视频帧率。单位：FPS，取值：1~60
fields.name: fps

fields.help_en: The group of pictures (GOP) of the output video. Unit: frame. Valid values: 1 to 3000
fields.help_zh: 视频GOP（Group of Picture）。单位：帧，取值：1~3000
fields.name: gop

fields.help_en:
The height of the output video. Valid values:

Height ≥ 128

max (Height,Width) ≤ 2560

min(Height,Width)≤ 1440

The resolution of a video transcoded by using the H.265 Narrowband HD template cannot exceed 1,280 × 720 pixels
fields.help_zh:
转码视频高度。取值：

Height ≥ 128
max（Height,Width）≤ 2560
min（Height,Width）≤ 1440

H.265窄带高清模板不得超过1280×720
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The video encoding profile. The profile determines how a video is encoded. In most cases, a greater value indicates better image quality and higher resource consumption. Valid values:

1: baseline. This value is suitable for mobile devices.

2: main. This value is suitable for standard-definition devices.

3: high. This value is suitable for high-definition devices
fields.help_zh:
编码级别。视频支持的一组特定的编码功能，一般值越大得到的画面质量越好，同时编解码消耗的资源也越高。取值：
1：baseline（适合移动设备）。
2：main（适合标准分辨率设备）。
3：high（适合高分辨率设备）
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en:
The width of the output video. Valid values:

Width ≥ 128

max (Height,Width) ≤ 2560

min(Height,Width)≤ 1440

The resolution of a video transcoded by using the H.265 Narrowband HD template cannot exceed 1,280 × 720 pixels
fields.help_zh:
转码视频宽度。取值：
Width ≥ 128
max（Height,Width）≤ 2560
min（Height,Width）≤ 1440

H.265窄带高清模板不得超过1280×720
fields.name: width
